green.scope: Final read-only permanent revocation, true WebSocket echo before/disconnect after settings change, backend close requested, failed settings-persist control, existing native/lock/settings/shutdown tests.

notes: Every native lease owns cancellable context and once-only backend close. Read-only is rechecked at lease lookup; successful settings persistence deletes and cancels all old leases, so restoring writable cannot revive them.

Proxy requests inherit lease cancellation via context.AfterFunc, which also disconnects an already-upgraded ReverseProxy WebSocket. Watcher teardown is tracked by App lifecycle; shutdown cancels leases and waits for bounded backend close without holding App.mu during that close.

Failed settings save keeps old writable lease; unknown save state and persistent marker protections remain. Connection revocation is not a saved-file acknowledgement or rollback of already-dispatched backend operations.
